scope.recovery: fresh sender file from authoritative witness image
scope.retry: same original tick request ID and expected logical tick
scope.clock: constant 100 in the experiment; expired cut commands rejected by the profile

r10_obligations: all physical sample attempts are logged separately from committed L1 calls
a precommit discarded tape may differ from the tape chosen on retry
private snapshot access starts only after a previously durable L1
a committed tape is preserved on restore and exact retry
durable private state and result match the fixed-work kernel prefix at the public program counter
a committed tick retry stutters logical state although its guarded transaction adds one witness CAS

observations.TICK_UNAVAILABLE: trusted coordinator receives no result after an explicit process exit; no invented network status code
observations.RECOVER: coordinator recovery completion; generated logical state stutters
observations.TICK_RETRY: same logical tick identity; advances only if the original tick was not durable

excluded: full differential privacy or cryptographic reduction
shared_kernel_caveat: R10 shares CountJob and HistogramJob with existing models; it checks encrypted ledger integration, not independent correctness of the primitive algorithms.
